create_dotproduct_classifier: create a DotProduct_Classifier with a specified number of classes and feature dimension
create_model_with_weights: create a DotProduct classifier model loaded with pretrained stage1 weights from a dataset
create_model_random_init: create a DotProduct classifier model with randomly initialized weights for testing
forward_pass_classifier: run a forward pass through the DotProduct classifier on input feature tensors
review_classifier_init: review the DotProduct_Classifier init to understand the linear layer configuration
